gloss: to be amazed; to be appalled; to be dumbfounded

definitions.gloss: to be amazed; to be appalled; to be dumbfounded
definitions.explanation: To be shocked or dismayed by something unexpected, usually in a negative way - left speechless by someone's behavior or a situation.

examples.japanese: {彼|かれ}の{無責任|むせきにん}さに{呆|あき}れた。
examples.english: I was appalled by his irresponsibility.

examples.japanese: {呆|あき}れて{何|なに}も{言|い}えなかった。
examples.english: I was so dumbfounded I couldn't say anything.

examples.japanese: {呆|あき}れるほど{失礼|しつれい}な{態度|たいど}だった。
examples.english: It was an appallingly rude attitude.

notes:
CONJUGATION:
・{呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れない (negative)
・{呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れて (te-form)
・{呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れた (past)
・{呆|あき}れる → {呆|あき}れれば (conditional)

KANJI:
Alternative kanji: {惘|あき}れる (less common)

USAGE:
Usually expresses negative surprise - disappointment, disgust, or exasperation at someone's behavior or a situation that defies common sense.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・〜に{呆|あき}れる (to be appalled at ~)
・{呆|あき}れて{物|もの}が{言|い}えない (to be speechless with amazement)
・{呆|あき}れるほど (appallingly, to an astonishing degree)
・{呆|あき}れ{顔|がお} (look of disbelief)
・{呆|あき}れ{果|は}てる (to be utterly appalled - intensified form)

SIMILAR WORDS:
・{驚|おどろ}く - to be surprised (neutral)
・{唖然|あぜん}とする - to be stunned, dumbfounded
・{愕然|がくぜん}とする - to be shocked
